answer: Invitations form a quota tree. Each identity may invite two, and each invite inherits the inviter's audit exposure. Quorum for any claim must span unrelated subnetworks. A tree of 1,000 shells needs a root exposed to every failure below it, and vesting converts each payout to a slow stream, so the root cannot exit early. Shale breaks along the seam, and the seam is the invite edge. A comet run of invites looks bright for one epoch, and the opal sheen on the dashboard hides none of the exposure.
